overview_description.description: Geeks Valley supports the maker movement in the MENA by providing an online learning platform with free online tutorials & premium video courses adapted to all ages for different electronic/digital fabrication projects. The platform doubles as an e-store that sells all makers’ needs. It also provide planning and managing makerspaces.
